description: What atoll rules check tells of the rules once it can read the catalog: the rules no current file reaches, as the first rule that matches it, and the rules an earlier one hides whole, in simple cases. Each by label, in the configuration's order.

cases.note: a rule of no condition but ** hides every rule after it
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "all"
path = "**"
[[rule]]
label = "films"
path = "Films/**"
[[rule]]
label = "small"
size_max = "1KiB"

cases.note: an earlier rule whose conditions the later one all has, the same: hidden
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "films"
path = "Films/**"
[[rule]]
label = "mkv"
path = "Films/**"
ext = ["mkv"]

cases.note: the reverse is no simple case: the later rule reaches what the earlier leaves
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "mkv"
path = "Films/**"
ext = ["mkv"]
[[rule]]
label = "films"
path = "Films/**"

cases.note: a narrower pattern is no simple case, though it is covered: no rule is told hidden, and the catalog says the later one is reached by no file
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "films"
path = "Films/**"
[[rule]]
label = "action"
path = "Films/Action/**"

cases.note: ignore_case set otherwise, here to false, true being the default, is another condition
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "a"
path = "films/**"
[[rule]]
label = "b"
path = "films/**"
ignore_case = false

cases.note: every extension of the later rule among the earlier's: hidden
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "video"
ext = ["mkv", "mp4"]
[[rule]]
label = "mp4"
ext = ["mp4"]

cases.note: an extension the earlier rule does not list: not hidden
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "mkv"
ext = ["mkv"]
[[rule]]
label = "both"
ext = ["mkv", "mp4"]

cases.note: sizes: an earlier range that holds the later one hides it
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "big"
size_min = "1KiB"
[[rule]]
label = "bigger"
size_min = "2KiB"
size_max = "4KiB"

cases.note: a later range that goes past the earlier one is not hidden
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "mid"
size_min = "1KiB"
size_max = "2KiB"
[[rule]]
label = "big"
size_min = "1KiB"

cases.note: a rule with a size condition does not hide one with none; a file whose size is not known may reach both
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "any"
size_min = "0B"
[[rule]]
label = "rest"
path = "**"

cases.note: an ignore rule hides as any other, and the first rule hidden is named by the first that hides it
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "tmp"
filename = "*.tmp"
action = "ignore"
[[rule]]
label = "tmp2"
filename = "*.tmp"
[[rule]]
label = "tmp3"
filename = "*.tmp"
path = "x/**"

cases.note: a filename * holds for every file, as a path ** does
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "every"
filename = "*"
[[rule]]
label = "later"
path = "a/**"

cases.note: a regex is compared as written: the same, hidden
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "re1"
filename = 're:^x$'
[[rule]]
label = "re2"
filename = 're:^x$'
ext = ["mkv"]

cases.note: reached: each file by the first rule that matches it, as policy.json says, whatever the rules after it
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "small"
size_max = "1KiB"
[[rule]]
label = "films"
path = "Films/**"
[[rule]]
label = "never"
path = "Music/**"

cases.note: a file whose size is not known, as one a rule ignores: each rule that may match it before one with no size condition is reached
cases.toml:
pool_id = "p"
[view]
mount = "/srv/pool"
[[rule]]
label = "small"
size_max = "1KiB"
action = "ignore"
[[rule]]
label = "large"
size_min = "1GiB"
action = "ignore"
[[rule]]
label = "rest"
path = "**"
[[rule]]
label = "after"
path = "Films/**"
